`asm-exec` is the unmodified AWS Agent Toolkit runtime secret resolver.

Source: https://github.com/aws/agent-toolkit-for-aws/blob/e8c630949189f03b3dd77388c86b06a7f2f911a9/plugins/aws-core/skills/aws-secrets-manager/references/asm-exec

License: Apache-2.0, included in `LICENSE`. The deployment invokes this resolver;
it never reads or prints secret values itself.
